research.name: gooey-toast
research.note: React toast whose title pill and description body are drawn as one blob that morphs between pill and expanded shapes.

effects: title pill and description body fused into one blob outline with a concave joint
pill to blob morph as the toast expands
promise toast morphing in place from a loading pill to an expanded result
